Let A_{B} be the point of intersection of AA' and L_{B}, and let A_{C} be the point of intersection of AA' and L_{C}. Let A″ be the point of intersection of BA_{B} and CA_{C}. Define B″ and C″ cyclically. Then triangle A″B″C″ is perspective to triangle ABC, with perspector X_847.
